prompt:

Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — Newcastle (n.纽卡斯尔(英国港口城市)): A British port-city vignette featuring an arched steel bridge over a river and quayside warehouses, simple Newcastle geography cue.
TOP RIGHT — identify (v.鉴定，识别): An expert compares a damaged banknote-shaped paper with an intact sample under a magnifying glass, focusing on matching design features.
BOTTOM LEFT — spokeswoman (n.女发言人): A professional woman addresses two reporters at a lectern with a microphone, blank speech bubble and folders nearby.
